name: Hatenaki Sora
source:
Main character is a new doctor. He starts to ask himself what's the true mission of the doctor and struggles to find the answers. However, he soon faces a new test... a girl with intractable disease.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名新手医生。他开始追问医生真正的使命究竟是什么，并努力寻找答案。然而，他很快面临新的考验…一名患有疑难病症的少女。
